theme: Steven Bonta partial decipherment, distributional fields, lexical chance and ICIT source history
question: Do Bonta's structural observations reproduce on pinned corpora, do identifiable anchor readings exceed a fixed lexical chance model, and is the claimed ICIT check demonstrably reserved at object level?
outcome: On 2469 selected objects jar 740 is final 838/1196 (70.07%) with 358 non-final tokens (29.93%), 241 followed by 400/090; arrow 520 is final 192/225 (85.33%) with 33 non-final (14.67%). Strong final tendencies reproduce; categorical sequence-final use fails, with T-field boundaries unresolved. Exploratory fish adjacency is 135 pairs against shuffle mean 54.5505, 95% range 44–65, 2000 draws; zero repeats/maximum-three runs are withdrawn as structural support. The selected lexical panel gives 9/10 exact matches. Global normalization is broader than Table 18 role lists. All 13 normalized assignments reaching at least 9 keep PU; none of the 600 moving it reaches 9. Eight of ten strings contain PU or PATI, which he derived by searching this dictionary against those same contexts, so the 13/720 tail is close to circular for these signs. Holding PU/PATI fixed gives normalized 8/24 and exact 2/24 tails; dropping their eight strings leaves 2/2, with tails 8/24 and 4/24. The corrected source-history audit has three repeated objects, zero conflicting labels among six candidates and three parser false overlaps: only ICIT3656 is an ICIT-first reading, ICIT3084 is an MH-first alias and ICIT2816 an iconography remark. Eight same-entry MH references remain, one uncertain. Validation membership, attempt/failure denominators and full field boundaries remain unknown; physical quantity joins are zero. All 126 original ledger rows were checked, including 74 outside the review sample, all 74 of which changed, mainly table/evidence clarifications; four additions give 130 rows. Kalyanaraman substantive content is unverified after HTTP 403.
challenge: Dictionary-derived roles and development-selected examples make the original lexical tail dependent on construction. Full manuscript figures, a complete historical ICIT attempt list, fine sign/field mappings and physical quantity joins are missing. Parser excerpts can attach adjacent aliases incorrectly. Machine captions remain unchecked against audio; Kalyanaraman access failed HTTP 403.
remedy: Preserved frozen runs, protocol/selection hashes, original audit and reviewer files; registered Exploratory response sensitivities; held dictionary-derived roles fixed and removed their strings; counted terminal exceptions and fish adjacency; issued a dated selection erratum and source-qualified validation successor; checked all existing ledger rows and recorded every change; corrected source access and evidence ranking.
retry_when: Obtain full manuscript figures, source-qualified fine identities/field boundaries, the historical ICIT attempted/rejected list and values fixed before consultation, or independent inscription-to-quantity joins. Use externally reserved objects and finite acceptance rules for a lexical test that models value/panel selection. Complete the full reading inventory and edition collation when witnesses are available.
